message: Invalid request format: 'VideoObject' object has no attribute 'choices'
behaviour: POST /v1/videos with {"model": "sora-2", "prompt": "a cat", "seconds": "4", "size": "720x1280"} returns HTTP 400 {"error": {"message": "Invalid request format: 'VideoObject' object has no attribute 'choices'", "type": "invalid_request_error", "code": "400"}}. The provider dashboard shows three queued video jobs for that one request.
